status.description: done = every open finding the brief listed has an entry below; blocked = you could not finish (say what stopped you).

message.description: One paragraph: what you re-proved by execution, what you could not, and anything the fix commits changed beyond the findings.

verifications.description: One entry PER OPEN FINDING the brief listed, by its r<round>-<dimension>-<n> id. resolved = the fix commits close it and the command below proves it; open = still there (quote what still shows it); refuted = the finding was wrong (quote the evidence). A closure without BOTH evidence fields is refused by the driver and the finding stays open — a paragraph is not a closure.

evidence_command.description: The command you ran in $REVIEW_WT that shows the verdict.

observed_output.description: What it printed, trimmed to the lines that decide it.
